/bin/sh -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
src=json.loads(Path('/spec/formal-context.json').read_text())
p='Research.BlockJacobi.'
common='For every natural number n (including 0), put I = {0,...,n-1} = Fin n. RealMatrix n means the real matrices indexed by I × I, and Vector n means the real functions on I. Matrix-vector multiplication is (Mv)_i = sum over j in I of M_ij v_j; matrix products and nonnegative integer powers have their usual meanings, with M"'^0 the identity. Write |v| and |M| for entrywise absolute values, ||v||∞ = max({0} ∪ {|v_i| : i in I}), and ||M||∞ = max({0} ∪ {sum over j in I of |M_ij| : i in I}). Thus both norms are 0 when n=0.
